bundles.faq_1_q: What's the difference between my plan and a bundle?
bundles.faq_1_a: Your subscription sets the base monthly limits for stories and audio. Bundles are one-time add-ons that raise those limits until the end of your current billing period.
bundles.faq_2_q: How long do bundle bonuses last?
bundles.faq_2_a: Extra credits from bundles apply until {{periodEnd}}. Anything you don’t use expires then and does not roll over.
bundles.faq_2_a_no_date: They apply until the end of your current billing period and do not roll over.
bundles.faq_3_q: Can I buy more than one bundle?
bundles.faq_3_a: Yes. Purchases in the same billing period stack—the extra stories and audio add together.
bundles.faq_4_q: Why is the bundle price different on higher plans?
bundles.faq_4_a: Higher plans include more illustrations per story, so generation costs more. Bundle prices follow the plan you’re on.
bundles.faq_5_q: Where can I pay for a bundle?
bundles.faq_5_a: When payments are enabled, checkout runs on the web. Open this page in a browser and use Buy on a card (mobile in-app purchase for bundles may follow later).
bundles.faq_6_q: Do bundles change image quality, style, or voices?
bundles.faq_6_a: No. Only your story and audio limits change. Illustration quality, style, and narrator voices stay the same as your plan.
bundles.section_subtitle_no_date: More limits this billing period. Illustrations per story unchanged.
bundles.stripe_required: Bundle purchase is available on the web when payments are enabled.
bundles.empty: No bundles available for your plan.

plans.faq_renewal_a: Les abonnements payants se renouvellent chaque mois jusqu’à leur annulation. Vous pouvez gérer ou annuler la facturation dans le portail de paiement lorsqu’il est disponible.
plans.faq_bundles_a: Les packs sont des ajouts ponctuels pour la période de facturation en cours. Les crédits non utilisés expirent à la fin de la période et ne sont pas reportés.
plans.faq_refunds_a: Les demandes de remboursement sont examinées par le support et ne sont pas automatiques après l’annulation d’un abonnement.
plans.payments_disabled_notice: Paid checkout is not enabled yet. Free access remains available while we finish billing verification.

plans.billing_note_bundles: Bundles are one-time add-ons for the current billing period. Unused bundle credits expire at period end and do not roll over.
plans.billing_note_refunds: Refund requests are reviewed through support and do not happen automatically when a subscription is canceled.
